name: Napat Wattanapong (Ploy)
whatIEnjoy: Designing user-friendly web interfaces, building interactive frontend applications, and collaborating on creative student tech projects.
whatIveTried: HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap 5, Vanilla JavaScript, Git/GitHub workflow, and Figma UI prototyping.
whatImCuriousAbout: React.js, TypeScript, accessible web design (WCAG), and full-stack development with Node.js.

items.title: POWER UP! Learning Portfolio Web App
items.description: Developed a responsive single-page learning portfolio web application for CS100 using HTML5, Bootstrap 5, and vanilla JavaScript with localStorage persistence.

reflection.whatIDid: Designed the pastel pink theme, structured the responsive layout with Bootstrap grid, and implemented form validation and localStorage state management.
reflection.whatILearned: Learned how to manage structured JSON data in browser localStorage and coordinate Git branches with teammates without merge conflicts.
reflection.challenge: Ensuring form inputs validated cleanly before saving and keeping the layout responsive on smaller mobile viewports.
reflection.nextStep: Add search and filter capabilities by skill tags and support exporting portfolios as PDF or downloadable JSON files.

items.title: Campus Sustainability Hackathon Prototype
items.description: Created an interactive mobile prototype for tracking reusable cup rewards across campus cafes during a 48-hour student hackathon.

reflection.whatIDid: Conducted quick interviews with 15 students, mapped user flows, and built a clickable high-fidelity prototype in Figma.
reflection.whatILearned: Learned how to rapidly validate assumptions with real users and prioritize core features under strict time constraints.
reflection.challenge: Balancing gamification features with a fast, frictionless QR scan checkout flow for busy coffee shop queues.
reflection.nextStep: Build a working progressive web app (PWA) MVP and test it with one campus student-run cafe.
